race.comment: ALL MOONLITE (7) is a lightly raced older mare who ran a good race first up here, sent out a $19 hope but running on well for fourth over 1400m. Expected to improve off that and the rise to 1700m will suit nicely. WINTER ARC (10) has run fourth in both starts to date, battling on well last time over this trip on very tough going. Fitter again for that and sets up well from the inside. HIS LADY BAY (8) tackled a stronger maiden at Geelong last time and was solid, finishing sixth. Drawn wide but is rock-hard fit and can take this out. LE PLUS RAPIDE (4) has mixed form of late, still a maiden after 26 starts. The run two back here was okay. SHAW CAN FLY (5) next best on resumption.
